content.short: Thetanuts Finance is a decentralized altcoin options protocol on Mantle offering structured yield products and on-chain options for a wide range of assets.
content.description: Thetanuts Finance specializes in altcoin options  a market largely underserved by other DeFi options platforms  offering covered call vaults, put selling strategies, and advanced option products through its lending infrastructure. The protocol minimizes losses for option writers while maximizing liquidity and access for option buyers through innovative mechanism design. Deployed on Mantle, Thetanuts brings sophisticated on-chain derivatives trading to a broad range of assets beyond just ETH and BTC.
